# Computer Care — Custom PC Builder & Genuine Hardware Store

> Computer Care (computercare.in) is India's premier custom PC configurator and hardware destination, featuring real-time 3D cabinet visualization, automated socket/chipset/RAM/wattage compatibility checks, and a verified catalog of 3,200+ authentic computer parts.

## Core Capabilities
- **Custom PC Builder**: Real-time component selection, live PSU wattage meter, zero-bottleneck matching, and 3D visual preview.
- **Pre-Built Gaming & Workstation PCs**: Factory-assembled and stress-tested rigs ranging from budget office desktop combos (₹9,999) to ultimate RTX 5090 creator workstations.
- **Genuine Hardware**: 100% brand-warranty parts from Intel, AMD, NVIDIA, ASUS, Gigabyte, MSI, Cooler Master, DeepCool, Corsair, Zebronics, Intex, Geonix, TVS, Logitech, Dell, and HP.
- **Expert Hardware Consultation**: Request a free call or consultation directly from custom PC hardware specialists.
- **Bulk & B2B Orders**: Dedicated supply chain for esports cafes, schools, CAD/editing studios, and enterprise IT deployments.
